summary: A third GPU thread, better Switch 2 Edition support, and game fixes.

changes.title: A third GPU thread
changes.body: Eligible Switch 2 Vulkan draws use a third recording thread.

changes.title: Ocarina of Time above 60 FPS
changes.body: FPS Unlock fixes Epona's fence jump, the day/night clock and the Deku Tree webs. The game no longer freezes after closing the R1 menu.

changes.title: Switch 2 games in HOME and better Edition support
changes.body: Launch games from HOME without installing them. Lichii better detects and launches Switch 2 Editions, applies matching upgrade packs, and keeps update information in NUPs.

changes.title: Precompile All Shaders
changes.body: Turn it on for individual games in their right-click menu. Precompilation can now find compute shaders in asset packs such as Kirby Air Riders' packs.

changes.title: Xenoblade DE and Yoshi fixes
changes.body: Fixes Xenoblade DE's title-screen textures and docked/handheld crash. Yoshi no longer crashes when Vulkan rejects a texture-buffer view.

changes.title: Multiplayer room connections
changes.body: The room proxy keeps the right player address and port and drops packets left over from earlier connections.

changes.title: What's New in Lichii
changes.body: See the highlights after an update or reopen them anytime from Help, even offline.
